paper_title: Alkyl Side-Chain Engineering in Wide-Bandgap Copolymers Leading to Power Conversion Efficiencies over 10%
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Advanced Materials - 2016 - Liu - Alkyl Side‐Chain Engineering in Wide‐Bandgap Copolymers Leading to Power Conversion/auto/Advanced Materials - 2016 - Liu - Alkyl Side‐Chain Engineering in Wide‐Bandgap Copolymers Leading to Power Conversion.md

knowledge_points.content: A series of wide-bandgap copolymers (PBT1-MP, PBT1-EH, and PBT1-BO) were synthesized using benzodithiophene (BDT) as the electron-rich unit and benzodithiophene-4,8-dione (BDTDO) as the electron-deficient unit.
knowledge_points.evidence: The copolymers consist of identical polymeric backbones with benzodithiophene (BDT) as the electron-rich unit and benzodithiophene-4,8-dione (BDTDO) as the electron-deficient unit... Various bulky side chains of R1 [R1 = 2-methylpropyl (MP), 2-ethylhexyl (EH), and 2-butyloctyl (BO)] and R2 (R2 = 2-hexyldecyl, 2-butyloctyl, and 2-ethylhexyl) were introduced.

knowledge_points.content: The PBT1-EH:PC71BM-based organic solar cell achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 10.3%, with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.97 V, a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 14.22 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 75.1%.
knowledge_points.evidence: the PBT1-EH:PC71BM solar cell showed a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 14.22 mA cm-2, an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.97 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 75.1% producing an overall efficiency of 10.3%.

knowledge_points.content: When blended with the non-fullerene acceptor ITIC-Th and processed with 1% chloronaphthalene (CN), PBT1-EH achieved a PCE of 10.6%.
knowledge_points.evidence: With the addition of 1% chloronaphthalene (CN) additive, the PCE was improved to 10.6% with a Jsc of 15.62 mA cm-2, a Voc of 0.97, and a FF of 69.8%

knowledge_points.content: The length of the alkyl side chain on the BDTDO acceptor unit influences molecular geometry; the longest side chain in PBT1-MP causes steric hindrance leading to a twisted backbone, whereas PBT1-EH and PBT1-BO maintain nearly planar geometries.
knowledge_points.evidence: PBT1-MP bearing the longest alkyl side chain on the acceptor unit resulted in a twisted molecular geometry, which is mainly ascribed to the large steric hindrances caused by the bulkier side chains on BDTDO unit. In contrast, PBT1-EH and PBT1-BO both have nearly planar molecular geometry.

knowledge_points.content: Increasing the length of the alkyl side chain on the BDTDO motif in this polymer series results in a deeper HOMO level, with values ranging from -5.40 eV (PBT1-BO) to -5.49 eV (PBT1-MP).
knowledge_points.evidence: The corresponding HOMO/LUMO levels of PBT1-MP, PBT1-EH, and PBT1-BO are -5.49/-3.46 eV, -5.43/-3.43 eV, and -5.40/-3.41 eV, respectively. One can find that increasing the length of alkyl chain substituents on BDTDO motif leads to a deeper HOMO level.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgaps (Eg^opt) of the polymers vary slightly with side-chain modifications, measured at 1.86 eV for PBT1-MP, 1.84 eV for PBT1-EH, and 1.81 eV for PBT1-BO.
knowledge_points.evidence: Eg^opt values of these polymers calculated from the absorption edge are 1.86 eV (PBT1-MP), 1.84 eV (PBT1-EH), and 1.81 eV (PBT1-BO), respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The optimal concentration of the solvent additive 1,8-diiodooctane (DIO) for the PBT1 series:PC71BM blend films was found to be 0.5%, which significantly improved PCE from below 4% to up to 10.3%.
knowledge_points.evidence: The optimal DIO concentration was found to be 0.5% for all the blend films... Without using DIO, all devices incorporating these three copolymers show rather low PCEs (< 4%)... the PBT1-EH:PC71BM solar cell showed... an overall efficiency of 10.3%.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS characterization indicates that all three polymers (PBT1-MP, PBT1-EH, PBT1-BO) exhibit a preferred face-on molecular orientation in neat films, with π-π stacking distances of approximately 3.69–3.72 Å.
knowledge_points.evidence: Very weak lamellar diffraction peaks and strong π-π stacking peaks were observed in the out-of plane direction, indicating that a preferred face-on molecular orientation in all neat films. The (010) π-π stacking peaks... corresponds to π-π stacking distances of ≈ 3.72, 3.69, and 3.69 Å, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: PBT1-EH:PC71BM films exhibit high and balanced carrier mobilities, with hole and electron mobilities of 1.94 × 10⁻³ and 2.87 × 10⁻³ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, respectively, supporting high Jsc and fill factor values.
knowledge_points.evidence: The hole and electron mobilities of PBT1-EH:PC71BM films were measured as 1.94 × 10-3 and 2.87 × 10-3 cm2 V-1 s-1... The high and balanced hole and electron mobility helps to explain the high Jsc and FF achieved in PBT1-EH:PC71BM devices.

knowledge_points.content: Resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSoXS) revealed that adding 1% CN to PBT1-EH:ITIC-Th blends reduced the domain size from 145 nm to 35 nm and increased relative domain purity, which enhances exciton dissociation and FF.
knowledge_points.evidence: The domain size in the PBT1-EH:ITIC-Th films with CN additive is 35 nm, which is much smaller than that (145 nm) in PBT1-EH:ITIC-Th films without CN additive... The relative domain purity is 0.78 for PBT1-EH:ITIC-Th films while the purity of blend films processed with CN additive is 1.

knowledge_points.content: The PBT1 series copolymers are thermally stable up to temperatures exceeding 305 °C, though PBT1-MP shows a minor degradation step (0.2% weight loss) at approximately 150 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: these copolymers are thermally stable with a decomposition temperature beyond 305 °C under nitrogen... PBT1-MP exhibits a small degradation step with ≈ 0.2% weight loss at ≈ 150 °C.

knowledge_points.content: The photovoltaic performance of PBT1-EH:PC71BM devices is sensitive to active layer thickness; the PCE drops from 10.3% at 130 nm to 7.6% at 210 nm due to a significant reduction in fill factor.
knowledge_points.evidence: At the active layer thickness of 130 nm, solar cells showed the best photovoltaic performance. When the thickness was increased to 160 nm the PCE was decreased to 9.3%. Further increasing the thickness up to 210 nm the PCE dropped to 7.6% due to the dramatically reduced FF.
